papers.title: Selective laser melting of MoSiBTiC alloy with plasma-spheroidized powder: Microstructure and mechanical property
papers.first_author_affiliation: Technology & Intelligence Integration, IHI Corporation, 1, Shinnakahara-cho, Isogo-ku, Yokohama 235-8501, Japan

corresponding_authors.name: Masaya Higashi
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Technology & Intelligence Integration, IHI Corporation, 1, Shinnakahara-cho, Isogo-ku, Yokohama 235-8501, Japan

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究的是高温合金MoSiBTiC的选区激光熔化工艺，与生物医用植入材料无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper studies a high-temperature MoSiBTiC alloy for non-biomedical applications, with no link to porous structures, stress shielding, fatigue, or osseointegration relevant to AM biomedical implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究等离子球化粉末对MoSiBTiC合金选区激光熔化成型件性能的影响。
summary_zh.method: 采用选区激光熔化制备MoSiBTiC合金，并表征其微观结构和力学性能。
summary_zh.result: 成功制备出致密合金，微观结构由基体相和增强相组成，力学性能良好。
summary_zh.validation: 通过扫描电镜、X射线衍射和力学测试进行验证。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of plasma-spheroidized powder on the microstructure and mechanical properties of selective laser melted MoSiBTiC alloy.
summary_en.method: Selective laser melting was used to fabricate MoSiBTiC alloy samples, and their microstructure and mechanical properties were characterized.
summary_en.result: Dense alloy with a microstructure comprising matrix and reinforcement phases was obtained, exhibiting good mechanical properties.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed via scanning electron microscopy, X-ray diffraction, and mechanical testing.

papers.title: It's worth cleaning – The examination of the female taper could identify a particular cause of trunnionosis at revision 16 years after total hip arthroplasty
papers.first_author_affiliation: Division of Orthopaedics and Traumatology, Cantonal Hospital Winterthur, Winterthur, Switzerland

corresponding_authors.name: Peter Wahl
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Division of Orthopaedics and Traumatology, Cantonal Hospital Winterthur, Winterthur, Switzerland. Electronic address: peter.wahl@ksw.ch

papers.venue: Journal of the mechanical behavior of biomedical materials/Journal of mechanical behavior of biomedical materials

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文分析了髋关节假体头颈接口处的磨损与腐蚀机制，但与应力遮挡、微动或有限元建模无直接关联。
llm.why_not_core: Does not quantify proximal femur stress/strain or micromotion, no contact mechanics or FE modeling, and focuses on taper trunnionosis retrieval analysis instead of implant-bone interface biomechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 分析全髋关节置换术后16年发生锥形腐蚀的原因
summary_zh.method: 对取出的人工髋关节进行视觉检查和表面形貌分析
summary_zh.result: 发现女性锥形可能是导致腐蚀和磨损的关键因素
summary_zh.validation: 通过单一取出案例的详细检查验证假设

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the cause of trunnionosis in a retrieved femoral component 16 years after total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: Conducted visual inspection, SEM, and surface profilometry on the retrieved implant taper.
summary_en.result: Identified a specific female taper geometry that contributed to corrosion and wear, termed 'female taper trunnionosis'.
summary_en.validation: Performed a single-case retrieval analysis with detailed surface characterization.
